description: Comptage multimodal (Vélo, Trottinette, 2RM, VL, PL, Autobus-car) - Sites et trajectoires de comptage is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Jeu de données statiques décrivant les trajectoires liées aux sites de comptages multimodaux (Vélo, Trottinette, 2RM, VL, PL, Autobus-car). Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are DVD, comptage vélo, comptage routier, IoT, trottinettes, vélo. The portal shows 164 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
